verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since some payment orchestration products are self-hostable, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Checkout.com-operated services: hosted APIs, a hosted payment page, and a hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.checkout.com). The Node.js SDK and plugins are client-side integration libraries, not a deployable copy of the core product, so there is no evidence of a self-hosted deployment option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
